critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2521 lines — consider splitting the consultation/availability module (lines 2011-2296) into its own router file for maintainability.

book_consultation() uses timezone.utc when comparing slot times, but working hours (09:30-19:00) are naturally India time; if the admin is IST, past-slot filtering will drift by 5h30m. Consider a configurable BUSINESS_TZ.
decline_booking sets status='declined' which correctly frees the slot (since ACTIVE_BOOKING_STATUSES excludes it) — verified. Good.
_schedule_booking_email swallows all exceptions with generic logger.exception — this is fine given SMTP is INERT.
